## Requirements (contract § In scope)

1. Registry `exports/src/exports/data/quality_checks.toml` (ADR-154's
   named path): 27 checks GQ-01…GQ-27, each with id, statement,
   population, placement (I/M/R/P/S), mode (enforce | ratchet |
   report), threshold, basis class (B0–B5) and fixing row (the
   contract's CONF/PKG/GX/H-4/REL-04b/G2/TX-04 key → ticket map). A
   schema test validates every row.
2. Only mechanical checks gate (SIG-CONF-003): the validator refuses a
   gating mode on a B3/B4 basis; GQ-22 stays `report`; seed modes are
   L3's (GQ-20, GQ-24, GQ-27 `enforce`; ratchets carry L2's baselines as
   placeholders until P34.44b's baseline run).
3. Read-only harness `sig-ops quality run --placement …`: DSN with
   statement timeout + read-only session; TABLESAMPLE on large-table
   checks disclosed as block-sampled; every check reports offered +
   evaluated and fails on 0 evaluated (SIG-ENG-042, B4 G11); emits
   `sig.quality-report/1` + one `sig.probe-run/1`.
4. Ratchet engine (SIG-CONF-007): fail on regression past baseline;
   baselines move only toward threshold; a loosened baseline/threshold
   needs a new ADR id; `enforce` flips only in the fixing row; a ratchet
   regression marks the candidate Class S (P35.60's hook).
5. R-placement checks run over a local release copy (fixture in tests).
6. V15 hook: standalone entry point now; joins the release gate with
   P35.58.
7. GQ-19 registered `report`, `not_evaluable` until P35.32/P35.34
   telemetry lands — never a pass.

## Plan

- `exports/src/exports/data/quality_checks.toml` — `sig.quality-checks/1`
  versioned registry (27 `[[check]]` rows; fields: id, statement,
  population, placement[], mode, direction, threshold (`none|op value`),
  baseline (number | "pending"), unit, basis_class, fixing[], from,
  note).
- `exports/src/exports/quality.py` — `QualityCheck`/`CheckRegistry`/
  `load_registry`/`validate_registry` (schema + SIG-CONF-003 gating-mode
  refusal + fixing-row resolution against a caller-supplied ticket set),
  `evaluate_check` (mode-aware verdict), `diff_registry` (ratchet change
  rules), `build_quality_report`/`build_probe_run` (`sig.quality-report/1`
  + `sig.probe-run/1`, vacuous-pass guard: pass requires evaluated > 0;
  `not_evaluable` is never a pass).
- `ops/src/ops/quality.py` — `sig-ops quality run|gate` verbs.
  `run --placement M --dsn` (psycopg, `default_transaction_read_only=on`
  + `statement_timeout`) with per-check SQL evaluators for the M checks
  whose seams exist (GQ-03, GQ-05, GQ-07, GQ-11, GQ-13, GQ-15, GQ-18,
  GQ-21, GQ-24); file scans for GQ-14/GQ-27 over a `--scan-dir`
  release/build tree; the V*-consumed and seam-pending checks
  (GQ-02/06/08/09/10/12/16/17/19/20/23/25/26) report `not_evaluable`
  naming their owner row. `gate --report` is the standalone V15 hook.
- `exports/src/exports/cli.py` — `sig-exports quality validate|diff`
  (the ruleset verbs live with the registry's package).
- `ops/src/ops/cli.py` — dispatch the `quality` module entry.
- ADR-204 — the registry schema + outcome vocabulary
  (`not_evaluable`/`unbaselined`) + the enforce-flip/loosening change
  rules (owned decisions).
- Tests: `tests/exports/test_quality_registry.py`,
  `tests/exports/test_quality_engine.py`, `tests/ops/test_quality_runner.py`
  (stub-conn evaluators + file scans + record shapes),
  `tests/db/test_quality_probe.py` (seeded spine; Docker-gated under
  `SIG_REQUIRE_DB_TESTS=1`).

### Deviation notes (owning ADRs)

- **Enforce-seed GQ-24 semantic**: the statement's "1g without a
  namespace" is read literally — `1g:shared_upstream_ref` is a namespace
  join (deterministic) and stays legal; unknown 1g labels fail closed
  into the locked set. Recorded in ADR-204's diff/semantics section.
- **`unbaselined` outcome**: ratchet checks with `baseline = "pending"`
  (P34.44b owns the baseline run) report `unbaselined` — recorded, never
  gating — an ADR-204 vocabulary addition beyond the contract's three.
- **GQ-11 without a lineage seam**: every overlap counts as undeclared
  (matches L2's "0 declared") until CONF-04 (P35.25) lands the seam.
- **GQ-13 approximation**: distinct literal values stand in for "beyond
  predicate tolerance" until a per-predicate tolerance catalog exists;
  disclosed in `detail.approximation`.
- **OM-16 size:** ~3,734 changed lines excl. generated files and fixtures
  (~3,771 total) — over the 3,000 M budget. The bulk is irreducible: the
  27-row registry TOML (435), the ruleset engine (772), the runner (840)
  and four test files (1,275); a split would have separated a check's
  declaration from its engine semantics. Recorded, not hidden — no
  in-budget claim (P34.43 ~3.1k / P34.49 ~3.8k precedent).
